title: Battle of the Cumberland Gap (1863)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Cumberland Gap (1863)", at revision 1380714259, opens: "The September 7–9, 1863 fall of the Cumberland Gap was a victory for Union forces under the command of Ambrose Burnside during his American Civil War campaign for Knoxville. The bloodless engagement cost the Confederates 2,300 men captured and control of the Cumberland Gap." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2514427, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1863 Bloodless battle during the American Civil War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
